title: CompareResponse
description: Comparative socio-economic synthesis across 2 to 5 Great Britain postcodes.

ComparisonSynthesis.description: Automated synthesis highlighting extremes, value outliers, and comparative trade-offs

metrics_summary.description: Raw underlying comparison metrics returned side-by-side for objective multi-criteria agent evaluation

scale_directions.description: Explicit documentation of score polarities and caveats for calling agents

affluence_score_100.example: Higher is more affluent (1-100 scale, calibrated against national deciles)

crime_safety_decile.example: Higher is safer (Decile 10 = lowest recorded crime per capita; Decile 1 = highest recorded crime)

price_per_sqm_gbp.example: Lower represents lower nominal cost per unit area (entry barrier), though not inherently superior quality

broadband_speed_tier_mbps.example: Higher indicates faster fixed-line broadband download throughput tier

family_suitability_score_100.example: Higher indicates greater family orientation (evaluates statutory crime safety, education and skills deprivation deciles, and child/parenting household demographics)

synthesis_notes.example: SW1A 1AA commands higher property prices per sqm and high affluence (94), while BB7 3BB (Dunsop Bridge, centre of GB) offers superior family suitability and lowest crime.

comparability_caveats.description: Cross-border statutory methodology caveats when comparing postcodes across England, Scotland, or Wales
example: Cross-nation comparison between England and Scotland: Indices of Multiple Deprivation (English IoD 2025, Welsh WIMD 2025, Scottish SIMD 2020) evaluate relative ranks strictly within each sovereign home nation and are not directly equivalent across borders.

PostcodeIntelligenceResponse.description: Comprehensive Great Britain postcode socio-economic profile. Sliced views prune optional metric blocks to optimize LLM context window token efficiency: full (complete 113-metric profile, default), brief/summary/ai (summary_for_ai, location, _attribution, _licensing, _billing, ~80 tokens), property (property_and_energy, digital_infrastructure), demographics (deprivation_deciles, census_demographics), education (schools_and_education), healthcare (healthcare_and_services), transit (transit), or services (education, healthcare, transit, digital_infrastructure). The _attribution property is strictly required and preserved across all view slices in accordance with statutory Open Government Licence v3.0, Ordnance Survey OpenData, and Crown copyright requirements.

match_type.description: Resolution accuracy: exact_unit (matched unit postcode in directory) or district_fallback (aggregated outcode postal district profile)

requested_postcode.description: Normalized display representation of the requested postcode

resolved_district.description: Outward postal district code if fallback was applied (null on exact unit matches)

note.example: Exact unit postcode not yet in Census/ONS directory. Returning aggregated SW1A district profile.
note.description: Explanatory contextual note for fallback profiles (null on exact unit matches)

_attribution.description: Official statutory Crown copyright and Open Government Licence v3.0 attribution statement (mandatory across all views)

BillingReceipt.description: Settled on-chain transaction receipt metadata under x402 payment specifications
